comment: bones.c savebones() and getbones() on the wizard2 level, whose des.teleport_region() leaves the Wizard's Tower boundary in svd.dndest. A debug Wizard level-teleports to wizard2 (not a branch level for seed 81234), wishes for a wand of death, zaps himself and saves bones. A debug Valkyrie with seed 81239, where wizard2 is again not a branch level, teleports there, gets and unlinks the bones, waits, and level-teleports away, so restore.c getlev() must restore dndest for do.c goto_level()'s In_W_tower() check, and its ghostly monster loop must run restore_cham() and hide_monst() per monster. Seeds and dates were chosen independently of every recorded session.
